List of gastruloid datasets

Source: vignettes/gastruloid_datasets.qmd

1 List of gastruloid datasets

Table 1 catalogues published studies that generate or analyse mouse or human gastruloids (or closely coupled trunk/TLS embryo models built from the same aggregation protocols). Methodological reviews are included when they focus on gastruloid variability and optimisation. Studies cited only for general differential-expression statistics (e.g. DESeq2, MAST benchmarking) are excluded.

Rows are drawn from data/gastruloid_and_atlas_merged.csv where catalogue == "gastruloid".
